pr_title: storage: flash_map: Fix checking unsigned for negative value
pr_body:
The unsigned size_t type variables have been checked for having
negative values.

Fixes #28171, Coverity-CID: 214224

Signed-off-by: Dominik Ermel <dominik.ermel@nordicsemi.no>

issue_context.title: [Coverity CID :214224] Unsigned compared against 0 in subsys/storage/flash_map/flash_map.c

review_comments: check on fac->off is missing, why?
Still, I think @de-nordic needs to address the question :)
(Hah!) And the problem this PR is addressing is that `off` is an unsigned type, so it can never be negative.

OK thanks for clarifying this @pabigot . This was not intuitive, since other similar checks in this line have been reworked from inequality checks (<= 0) to equality (==) so I was thinking this should be the same and was just overlooked (possibly because it was too offensive :) )
@ioannisg off is very positive when negative.
Hi folks, It was not intentional flash_area_check -> offset be offensive.
Maybe this can be refactored, then :)
Maybe leave it, it is funny :), it is one of these things that give you smile when you scan the code :)
